disease_label_per_paper: Primary splenic diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
presentation_summary: Upper left abdominal pain, early satiety, night sweats, and 8% weight loss over two months
On admission she was pale, tachycardic, and had palpable splenomegaly six centimetres below the left costal margin
Blood tests showed Hb 9 g/dL, platelets 445 x10^9/L, LDH 892 U/L, ESR 101 mm/h, CRP 17.30 mg/dL, and albumin 3.1 g/dL
Abdominal MRI showed multinodular splenomegaly measuring 15 x 11 x 17 cm
Ultrasound-guided spleen biopsy diagnosed primary splenic diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
